title: Business Volume Downgrade Credit — Northgate Memberships
content:
A member whose purchases with Northgate are large earns a business volume downgrade credit, added to the downgrade difference refund of a Northgate Memberships Plus membership. The credit is decided from the member's purchase records in Northgate Purchases & Returns. A membership with no current-year Plus premium gets no downgrade difference refund at all.

**Business purchase volume.** The member's merchandise sale lines posted in the twelve months before the downgrade less the merchandise returns posted in those months. A line falls within the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the downgrade date.

**Credit.** A business purchase volume of 6000.00 dollars or more adds a business volume downgrade credit of 7.50 dollars, one of 2000.00 dollars or more adds 3.00 dollars, and a smaller one adds nothing.

| Business purchase volume | Business volume downgrade credit |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 or more | 7.50 |
| 2000.00 to 5999.99 | 3.00 |
| below 2000.00 | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

| Sale lines in the twelve months | Returns in the twelve months | Volume | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6400.00 | 400.00 | 6000.00 | 7.50 |
| 6400.00 | 400.01 | 5999.99 | 3.00 |
| 2500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 | 3.00 |
| 2500.00 | 600.00 | 1900.00 | nothing |
